comment: * Ike3gppExtensionExchange contains the implementation for 3GPP-specific functionality in IKEv2.

variables.name: NOTIFY_TYPE_BACKOFF_TIMER
variables.comment:
* Indicates that the caller must wait the specified time before attempting to open an IKE * Session with the peer. * *

Note that this is not an IANA-specified value. * *

Must be accompanied by an Error-Notify(ERROR_TYPE_NO_APN_SUBSCRIPTION) or * Error-Notify(ERROR_TYPE_NETWORK_FAILURE); otherwise, the payload will be logged and ignored.

variables.name: NOTIFY_TYPE_N1_MODE_CAPABILITY
variables.comment:
* Indicates that the UE supports N1 Mode during 5G SA ePDG tunnel setup. * *

Note that this is not an IANA-specified value. * *

A PDU session ID will be included to indicate the PDU session associated with the IKEv2 * SA. * *

See TS 124 302 - Universal Mobile Telecommunications System (UMTS); LTE; 5G; Access to the * 3GPP Evolved Packet Core (EPC) via non-3GPP access networks (Section 8.2.9.15) for more * details.

variables.name: NOTIFY_TYPE_N1_MODE_INFORMATION
variables.comment:
* Used for reporting the S-NSSAI from the server to the UE for the reported PDU Session ID. * *

Note that this is not an IANA-specified value. * *

This Payload will only be sent from the server to the user device after {@link * NOTIFY_TYPE_N1_MODE_CAPABILITY} is sent during the IKE_AUTH exchange. * *

See TS 124 302 - Universal Mobile Telecommunications System (UMTS); LTE; 5G; Access to the * 3GPP Evolved Packet Core (EPC) via non-3GPP access networks (Section 8.2.9.16) for more * details.

variables.name: NOTIFY_TYPE_DEVICE_IDENTITY
variables.comment:
* Used to share the device idenity (IMEI/IMEISV) with the carrier network. * *

Note that this is not an IANA-specified value. * *

See TS 124 302 - Universal Mobile Telecommunications System (UMTS); LTE; 5G; Access to the * 3GPP Evolved Packet Core (EPC) via non-3GPP access networks (Section 8.2.9.2) for more * details.
